reviews.title: Don’t spend money on this, it barely functions, ask for refund.
reviews.text: Using the scanner lets the app crash, can’t even search products or brands, app only shows a white window that cuts off categories.

reviews.title: Do not download and purchase. No longer supported
reviews.text: Tried to join some campaigns and could not. This feature has not been supported for at least seven years. Have not tried scan feature to know if it works or has been updated. Why is this available for download and why is $1.99 being charged for download if the app is not current and supported??

reviews.title: Waste
reviews.text: I thought I was getting an app where I could determine if brands use child, slave or forced labor so I could avoid purchasing their products.  Instead I got a whiny app of left wing boycotts.  Stupid.

reviews.title: Waste of money
reviews.text: This app is a great idea with terrible execution. Tested with several very common brands and received no useful information about the conflicts and supporters for it. The interface for the corporate family tree is also extremely difficult to read and was inaccurate for at least one of the products I tested with.

reviews.title: buycott
reviews.text: I just bought this app, and every single time I tried to look up a product, it crashes. I haven’t been able to look up anything. Good idea, poorly executed software!

reviews.title: Outdated
reviews.text: Comments are from 9 years ago, boycotts seem outdated.

reviews.title: Seems to be defunct, unfortunately
reviews.text:
As far as I can tell this service stopped working years ago. 
As of November 2025, scanning produced no results. 
Also, boycott.com isn’t working.

reviews.title: No more updates?
reviews.text: App no longer works. Looks like it hasn’t been updated in at least 7 years.

reviews.title: Won’t let me set up an account without fb or twitter
reviews.text: I keep trying to sign up via email because I don’t use twitter or Facebook but it won’t let me. I paid for this app and should be required to use other apps just to create an account.
